rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act – Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources
rules.requirement: Any landlord planning to end a tenancy agreement must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources. The notice should be delivered at the same time as the Notice to Quit or Notice of Non-renewal of Lease.
rules.coverage_text: All landlords planning to end a tenancy agreement in Boston.
rules.penalty: Enforced by Inspectional Services Department: 1st offense warning; 2nd and subsequent offenses $300 per day. A violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.quoted_span: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires any landlord to provide renters with a Notice of Tenant’s Rights and Resources when planning to end a tenancy agreement.

rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act – City notification of Notice to Quit / Non-renewal
rules.requirement: Landlords and foreclosing owners must complete the Notice to Quit / Non-renewal of Lease Submission Verification Form through the City's online portal, providing tenant contact information and a copy of the Notice to Quit or Notice of Non-renewal of Lease.
rules.coverage_text: Landlords and foreclosing owners ending a tenancy in Boston.
rules.penalty: Failure to submit this information may result in a fine up to $300 per day.
rules.quoted_span: Landlords must use this online form to provide tenant contact information and upload a copy of the Notice to Quit or Notice of Non-renewal of Lease.
